# ECMWF-Viewer

Pre-rendered weather charts from ECMWF IFS open data (0.25 deg), in the style of the KMA
"예상일기도" viewer, generated by GitHub Actions and (later) served by GitHub Pages to an Android app.

Status: **Stage 0** (scaffolding + measurements). No deploy, no app yet.

- Brief / specification: [docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md)
- Data licence and attribution: [NOTICE](NOTICE) (ECMWF open data, CC BY 4.0)
- Renderer: `render/` (config in `render/config.toml`)
- Measurements: `measure/`, run by `.github/workflows/measure.yml`
  (push to the Stage 0 branch or *Run workflow*). Results: job summary + artifacts
  `stage0-results` and `stage0-images`.

## Local run

```bash
python3.13 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.lock
python -m measure.m1_sources   # downloads into ./work
python -m measure.m3_render
```
